content.subject: PR-5a1: Pictographic difficulty selectors (7 games)
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5a1 (~L213-217). Replace text "Easy / Medium / Hard" difficulty selectors with pictographic icons (🐣/🐱/🦁 or similar age-appropriate animals) across: PopBalloons, SimonSays, MemoryMatch, Snake, MathFacts, ShapeSorting, ColorMixer.

ACTIONS:
1. For each of the 7 games, find the difficulty selector UI in the Page.tsx (or in the in-game settings panel).
2. Replace text labels with emoji/icon buttons. Keep aria-label="Easy"/"Medium"/"Hard" intact for screen readers (this is the gemini critic's measurable acceptance — and good a11y).
3. Use consistent icons across all games: 🐣 (easy / baby chick), 🐱 (medium / cat), 🦁 (hard / lion). Add a "kid-button" Tailwind class for size if needed.

ACCEPTANCE:
- `grep -rE "(>Easy<|>Medium<|>Hard<)" src/components/Games/*/[A-Z]*Page.tsx` returns 0 matches in the difficulty-selector buttons themselves (the visible button text). Aria-labels MAY still contain those words (acceptable).
- All 7 games' difficulty selectors render the 3 emoji buttons (manual check)
- Each emoji has a corresponding aria-label

content.subject: PR-5a2: Win celebrations (3 games)

Pick ONE simple approach: either (a) hand-rolled emoji-burst animation using `position: absolute` divs + CSS keyframes already set up in PR-2 BubblePop pattern, or (b) add the `canvas-confetti` npm dep (~5KB minified). Plan v3 explicitly says DO NOT hand-roll a custom particle engine (the architect critic flagged this as risk).
2. For each game's game-over modal: trigger confetti + playSound('victory') (or 'gameover' for lose).

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5b: drawing Undo/Redo with 20-frame history"

content.description:

2. Render a vertical thermometer-style indicator: 0 = cold/empty, 1 = full/hot. Pulse animation when proximity > 0.95 (very close to match).
3. Place next to the target color swatch in ColorMixerPage.tsx.

Also explicitly disable canvas-confetti in useWinCelebration when prefers-reduced-motion matches (use `window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches`).
2. **visibilitychange pause**: in useJellyVolleyball, useSnakeGame, usePopBalloons — listen on `document.visibilitychange`, pause game loop / cancel rAF / clear interval when hidden, resume when visible. Cleanup listener on unmount.
3. **Google Fonts preconnect**: in index.html, replace any `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/...')` in src/index.css with `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">` + `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>` + `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/...&display=swap">` in index.html head.
4. **Constrain touch-action**: in src/index.css, replace the `* { touch-action: manipulation }` rule (which kills iOS scroll momentum per audit U7) with rules scoped only to game canvases (`.game-canvas, [data-touch-game] { touch-action: none; }`). Add the class to canvas elements as needed.

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5b: drawing Undo/Redo with 20-frame history"

content.subject: PR-6a: Accessibility compliance basics
content.description:

2. **Global focus-visible**: in src/index.css add `*:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ring, #6366f1); outline-offset: 2px; }`. Tailwind preflight strips browser defaults; this restores them per audit U11.
3. **ColorPicker keyboard activation**: in src/components/Tools/ColorPicker.tsx, swatches use `role="button"` divs but have no onKeyDown handler. Add `onKeyDown` that fires the same handler on Enter/Space keys.
4. **MathFacts input label**: add a `<label>` element associated with the answer input (currently placeholder-only violates WCAG 1.3.1 per audit U15).
5. **SimonSays glyph per color**: add a glyph/letter inside each colored button (W3C 1.4.1 requires more than color alone to distinguish UI elements).

ACCEPTANCE:
- **NEW automated Playwright test** `tests/e2e/keyboard-nav.spec.ts` (per gemini critic):
   * Load home page (use the pre-seeded firstRunComplete pattern from home-navigation.spec.ts beforeEach)
   * Press Tab until first tile gets focus
   * Assert focus outline visible (computed style check)
   * Press Enter, assert game opens

   * Assert OnboardingOverlay is visible
   * Click through 4 steps, assert dismissed
   * Reload, assert overlay NOT visible (firstRunComplete now true)

content.subject: PR-6b: Motion & timing
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-6b (~L253-258).

ACTIONS:
1. **prefers-reduced-motion**: in src/index.css add `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }`. Cuts the 47 animation usages identified in audit U10 when user has the OS setting on. Also explicitly disable canvas-confetti in useWinCelebration when prefers-reduced-motion matches (use `window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches`).
2. **visibilitychange pause**: in useJellyVolleyball, useSnakeGame, usePopBalloons — listen on `document.visibilitychange`, pause game loop / cancel rAF / clear interval when hidden, resume when visible. Cleanup listener on unmount.
3. **Google Fonts preconnect**: in index.html, replace any `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/...')` in src/index.css with `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">` + `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>` + `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/...&display=swap">` in index.html head.
4. **Constrain touch-action**: in src/index.css, replace the `* { touch-action: manipulation }` rule (which kills iOS scroll momentum per audit U7) with rules scoped only to game canvases (`.game-canvas, [data-touch-game] { touch-action: none; }`). Add the class to canvas elements as needed.

ACCEPTANCE:
- Manual verification: enable prefers-reduced-motion in DevTools, load BubblePop — bubbles still spawn but animations are near-instant
- Page Performance: with throttled mobile profile, Lighthouse mobile a11y ≥ 90 (note in PR description — measure once)
- Per-PR gate green (note: not all browsers test reduced-motion in CI, manual check OK)

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 6 PR-6b: prefers-reduced-motion, visibilitychange pause, font preconnect, touch-action scoping"

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored

content.subject: PR-6b: Motion & timing
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-6b (~L253-258).

ACTIONS:
1. **prefers-reduced-motion**: in src/index.css add `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }`. Cuts the 47 animation usages identified in audit U10 when user has the OS setting on. Also explicitly disable canvas-confetti in useWinCelebration when prefers-reduced-motion matches (use `window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches`).
2. **visibilitychange pause**: in useJellyVolleyball, useSnakeGame, usePopBalloons — listen on `document.visibilitychange`, pause game loop / cancel rAF / clear interval when hidden, resume when visible. Cleanup listener on unmount.
3. **Google Fonts preconnect**: in index.html, replace any `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/...')` in src/index.css with `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">` + `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>` + `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/...&display=swap">` in index.html head.
4. **Constrain touch-action**: in src/index.css, replace the `* { touch-action: manipulation }` rule (which kills iOS scroll momentum per audit U7) with rules scoped only to game canvases (`.game-canvas, [data-touch-game] { touch-action: none; }`). Add the class to canvas elements as needed.

ACCEPTANCE:
- Manual verification: enable prefers-reduced-motion in DevTools, load BubblePop — bubbles still spawn but animations are near-instant
- Page Performance: with throttled mobile profile, Lighthouse mobile a11y ≥ 90 (note in PR description — measure once)
- Per-PR gate green (note: not all browsers test reduced-motion in CI, manual check OK)

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 6 PR-6b: prefers-reduced-motion, visibilitychange pause, font preconnect, touch-action scoping"

1. For each of the 7 games, find the difficulty selector UI in the Page.tsx (or in the in-game settings panel).
2. Replace text labels with emoji/icon buttons. Keep aria-label="Easy"/"Medium"/"Hard" intact for screen readers (this is the gemini critic's measurable acceptance — and good a11y).
3. Use consistent icons across all games: 🐣 (easy / baby chick), 🐱 (medium / cat), 🦁 (hard / lion). Add a "kid-button" Tailwind class for size if needed.

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5b: drawing Undo/Redo with 20-frame history"

content.subject: PR-5c2: ColorMixer thermometer
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5c2 (~L236-237). Add proximity feedback indicator to ColorMixer. Independent.

ACTIONS:
1. Calculate proximity: `const distance = Math.sqrt((r-tr)**2 + (g-tg)**2 + (b-tb)**2) / Math.sqrt(255*255*3); const proximity = 1 - distance;` (proximity 0..1).
2. Render a vertical thermometer-style indicator: 0 = cold/empty, 1 = full/hot. Pulse animation when proximity > 0.95 (very close to match).
3. Place next to the target color swatch in ColorMixerPage.tsx.

ACCEPTANCE:
- src/hooks/useColorMixer.test.ts NEW (or extend):
   * "proximity is 1.0 at exact match" — current RGB equals target, assert proximity === 1
   * "proximity is 0 at max distance" — current black, target white, assert proximity === 0
- Per-PR gate green

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5c2: ColorMixer proximity thermometer indicator"

content.subject: PR-5d: First-run onboarding overlay
content.description:

   - Step 3: 🌟 "Check today's challenge!" — point to Daily Drawing Prompt

   Use big emoji + minimal text. Pre-readers should grok it from icons alone.
2. Each step has a "Next →" or "Got it!" button (final). Pre-readers can use emoji icons.
3. Gate visibility on `storage.get('firstRunComplete', false)`. On dismiss (any step's final button), `storage.set('firstRunComplete', true)`.
4. Wire into App.tsx so the overlay renders ABOVE HomePage on first load and never again.

ACCEPTANCE:

   * Mount with `firstRunComplete=false`, assert overlay visible
   * Click through to step 4 and dismiss, assert storage.get('firstRunComplete') === true
   * Re-render with `firstRunComplete=true`, assert overlay NOT in DOM
- Per-PR gate green

content.subject: PR-6a: Accessibility compliance basics
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-6a (~L245-251). The largest Phase 6 PR. Touches HomePage tiles, global CSS focus-visible, several game pages.

ACTIONS:
1. **aria-label every home tile button** in HomePage.tsx (currently screen readers announce raw emoji codepoint names per audit U9). Also: the 3 feature-highlight "tiles" that are non-interactive should get `role="presentation"` or be converted to non-button elements.
2. **Global focus-visible**: in src/index.css add `*:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ring, #6366f1); outline-offset: 2px; }`. Tailwind preflight strips browser defaults; this restores them per audit U11.
3. **ColorPicker keyboard activation**: in src/components/Tools/ColorPicker.tsx, swatches use `role="button"` divs but have no onKeyDown handler. Add `onKeyDown` that fires the same handler on Enter/Space keys.
4. **MathFacts input label**: add a `<label>` element associated with the answer input (currently placeholder-only violates WCAG 1.3.1 per audit U15).
5. **SimonSays glyph per color**: add a glyph/letter inside each colored button (W3C 1.4.1 requires more than color alone to distinguish UI elements).

ACCEPTANCE:
- **NEW automated Playwright test** `tests/e2e/keyboard-nav.spec.ts` (per gemini critic):
   * Load home page (use the pre-seeded firstRunComplete pattern from home-navigation.spec.ts beforeEach)
   * Press Tab until first tile gets focus
   * Assert focus outline visible (computed style check)
   * Press Enter, assert game opens
- **ALSO NEW** Playwright test `tests/e2e/onboarding.spec.ts` (per Phase 5 gemini recommendation — closes the e2e gap created by pre-seeding firstRunComplete elsewhere):
   * Load home page with EXPLICITLY NOT pre-seeded firstRunComplete (use a fresh context.addInitScript that removes the key OR omits it)
   * Assert OnboardingOverlay is visible
   * Click through 4 steps, assert dismissed
   * Reload, assert overlay NOT visible (firstRunComplete now true)
- `grep -c 'aria-label' src/components/HomePage.tsx` >= 14 (one per game tile + Gallery tile)
- ColorPicker: render in test, simulate Space keypress on a swatch, assert color changed
- Per-PR gate green: lint + type-check + test --run + test:games + test:touch + playwright + build

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 6 PR-6a: a11y compliance — aria-labels, focus-visible, keyboard nav, label, SimonSays glyphs + new onboarding e2e"

content.subject: PR-6b: Motion & timing
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-6b (~L253-258).

ACTIONS:
1. **prefers-reduced-motion**: in src/index.css add `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }`. Cuts the 47 animation usages identified in audit U10 when user has the OS setting on. Also explicitly disable canvas-confetti in useWinCelebration when prefers-reduced-motion matches (use `window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches`).
2. **visibilitychange pause**: in useJellyVolleyball, useSnakeGame, usePopBalloons — listen on `document.visibilitychange`, pause game loop / cancel rAF / clear interval when hidden, resume when visible. Cleanup listener on unmount.
3. **Google Fonts preconnect**: in index.html, replace any `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/...')` in src/index.css with `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">` + `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>` + `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/...&display=swap">` in index.html head.
4. **Constrain touch-action**: in src/index.css, replace the `* { touch-action: manipulation }` rule (which kills iOS scroll momentum per audit U7) with rules scoped only to game canvases (`.game-canvas, [data-touch-game] { touch-action: none; }`). Add the class to canvas elements as needed.

ACCEPTANCE:
- Manual verification: enable prefers-reduced-motion in DevTools, load BubblePop — bubbles still spawn but animations are near-instant
- Page Performance: with throttled mobile profile, Lighthouse mobile a11y ≥ 90 (note in PR description — measure once)
- Per-PR gate green (note: not all browsers test reduced-motion in CI, manual check OK)

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 6 PR-6b: prefers-reduced-motion, visibilitychange pause, font preconnect, touch-action scoping"

content.subject: PR-6c: Polish + perf (TetrisBoard memo + tile differentiation + age badges + ⓘ)
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-6c (~L260-264). Smaller polish-grade improvements.

ACTIONS:
1. **React.memo TetrisBoard CellView**: in src/components/Games/Tetris/TetrisBoard.tsx (or wherever CellView lives), wrap the cell component in React.memo. Currently all 200 cells re-render every 800ms tick.
2. **Differentiate 3 🎨 emoji tiles**: in HomePage.tsx — Color Blocks, Drawing Challenge, Color Mixer currently all use 🎨. Replace 2 of them with distinct emojis (🟪 for Color Blocks, 🌈 for Color Mixer, keep 🎨 for Drawing Challenge — or use your judgment). Pre-readers can't distinguish them otherwise per audit U22.
3. **Age badges**: small pill in corner of each home tile showing target age range. E.g., MathFacts → "🧒 5+", Sudoku → "🧒 7+", BubblePop → "🧒 3+". Use a consistent visual style. Get age data from audit Stage 6 V3 table or pick reasonable values.
4. **Mobile "How to play" ⓘ affordance**: per game, the existing "How to play" section is `hidden md:block` (per audit U23). Add a small ⓘ button in GameLayout (or per-page) that, when tapped, shows the instructions in a small popover/modal. Or alternatively: remove `hidden md:block` from the simplest possible games and make the instructions always visible inline at the bottom of the screen.

ACCEPTANCE:
- TetrisBoard: verify via React DevTools Profiler (or note expected behavior) that CellView is now memoized — cells should not re-render unless their props change
- HomePage: `grep -c '🎨' src/components/HomePage.tsx` returns ≤1
- Age badges: visible on all 14 home tiles (manual check + maybe a test that asserts the badge prop on the tile component)
- Mobile "How to play" affordance: works on a 360px viewport (manual confirm)

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

content.subject: PR-6b: Motion & timing
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-6b (~L253-258).

ACTIONS:
1. **prefers-reduced-motion**: in src/index.css add `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }`. Cuts the 47 animation usages identified in audit U10 when user has the OS setting on. Also explicitly disable canvas-confetti in useWinCelebration when prefers-reduced-motion matches (use `window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches`).
2. **visibilitychange pause**: in useJellyVolleyball, useSnakeGame, usePopBalloons — listen on `document.visibilitychange`, pause game loop / cancel rAF / clear interval when hidden, resume when visible. Cleanup listener on unmount.
3. **Google Fonts preconnect**: in index.html, replace any `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/...')` in src/index.css with `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">` + `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>` + `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/...&display=swap">` in index.html head.
4. **Constrain touch-action**: in src/index.css, replace the `* { touch-action: manipulation }` rule (which kills iOS scroll momentum per audit U7) with rules scoped only to game canvases (`.game-canvas, [data-touch-game] { touch-action: none; }`). Add the class to canvas elements as needed.

ACCEPTANCE:
- Manual verification: enable prefers-reduced-motion in DevTools, load BubblePop — bubbles still spawn but animations are near-instant
- Page Performance: with throttled mobile profile, Lighthouse mobile a11y ≥ 90 (note in PR description — measure once)
- Per-PR gate green (note: not all browsers test reduced-motion in CI, manual check OK)

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 6 PR-6b: prefers-reduced-motion, visibilitychange pause, font preconnect, touch-action scoping"

content.subject: PR-6c: Polish + perf (TetrisBoard memo + tile differentiation + age badges + ⓘ)
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-6c (~L260-264). Smaller polish-grade improvements.

ACTIONS:
1. **React.memo TetrisBoard CellView**: in src/components/Games/Tetris/TetrisBoard.tsx (or wherever CellView lives), wrap the cell component in React.memo. Currently all 200 cells re-render every 800ms tick.
2. **Differentiate 3 🎨 emoji tiles**: in HomePage.tsx — Color Blocks, Drawing Challenge, Color Mixer currently all use 🎨. Replace 2 of them with distinct emojis (🟪 for Color Blocks, 🌈 for Color Mixer, keep 🎨 for Drawing Challenge — or use your judgment). Pre-readers can't distinguish them otherwise per audit U22.
3. **Age badges**: small pill in corner of each home tile showing target age range. E.g., MathFacts → "🧒 5+", Sudoku → "🧒 7+", BubblePop → "🧒 3+". Use a consistent visual style. Get age data from audit Stage 6 V3 table or pick reasonable values.
4. **Mobile "How to play" ⓘ affordance**: per game, the existing "How to play" section is `hidden md:block` (per audit U23). Add a small ⓘ button in GameLayout (or per-page) that, when tapped, shows the instructions in a small popover/modal. Or alternatively: remove `hidden md:block` from the simplest possible games and make the instructions always visible inline at the bottom of the screen.

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5b: drawing Undo/Redo with 20-frame history"

content.subject: PR-6b: Motion & timing
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-6b (~L253-258).

ACTIONS:
1. **prefers-reduced-motion**: in src/index.css add `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }`. Cuts the 47 animation usages identified in audit U10 when user has the OS setting on. Also explicitly disable canvas-confetti in useWinCelebration when prefers-reduced-motion matches (use `window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches`).
2. **visibilitychange pause**: in useJellyVolleyball, useSnakeGame, usePopBalloons — listen on `document.visibilitychange`, pause game loop / cancel rAF / clear interval when hidden, resume when visible. Cleanup listener on unmount.
3. **Google Fonts preconnect**: in index.html, replace any `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/...')` in src/index.css with `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">` + `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>` + `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/...&display=swap">` in index.html head.
4. **Constrain touch-action**: in src/index.css, replace the `* { touch-action: manipulation }` rule (which kills iOS scroll momentum per audit U7) with rules scoped only to game canvases (`.game-canvas, [data-touch-game] { touch-action: none; }`). Add the class to canvas elements as needed.

ACCEPTANCE:
- Manual verification: enable prefers-reduced-motion in DevTools, load BubblePop — bubbles still spawn but animations are near-instant
- Page Performance: with throttled mobile profile, Lighthouse mobile a11y ≥ 90 (note in PR description — measure once)
- Per-PR gate green (note: not all browsers test reduced-motion in CI, manual check OK)

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 6 PR-6b: prefers-reduced-motion, visibilitychange pause, font preconnect, touch-action scoping"

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

content.subject: PR-6b: Motion & timing
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-6b (~L253-258).

ACTIONS:
1. **prefers-reduced-motion**: in src/index.css add `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }`. Cuts the 47 animation usages identified in audit U10 when user has the OS setting on. Also explicitly disable canvas-confetti in useWinCelebration when prefers-reduced-motion matches (use `window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches`).
2. **visibilitychange pause**: in useJellyVolleyball, useSnakeGame, usePopBalloons — listen on `document.visibilitychange`, pause game loop / cancel rAF / clear interval when hidden, resume when visible. Cleanup listener on unmount.
3. **Google Fonts preconnect**: in index.html, replace any `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/...')` in src/index.css with `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">` + `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>` + `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/...&display=swap">` in index.html head.
4. **Constrain touch-action**: in src/index.css, replace the `* { touch-action: manipulation }` rule (which kills iOS scroll momentum per audit U7) with rules scoped only to game canvases (`.game-canvas, [data-touch-game] { touch-action: none; }`). Add the class to canvas elements as needed.

ACCEPTANCE:
- Manual verification: enable prefers-reduced-motion in DevTools, load BubblePop — bubbles still spawn but animations are near-instant
- Page Performance: with throttled mobile profile, Lighthouse mobile a11y ≥ 90 (note in PR description — measure once)
- Per-PR gate green (note: not all browsers test reduced-motion in CI, manual check OK)

content.subject: PR-6c: Polish + perf (TetrisBoard memo + tile differentiation + age badges + ⓘ)
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-6c (~L260-264). Smaller polish-grade improvements.

ACTIONS:
1. **React.memo TetrisBoard CellView**: in src/components/Games/Tetris/TetrisBoard.tsx (or wherever CellView lives), wrap the cell component in React.memo. Currently all 200 cells re-render every 800ms tick.
2. **Differentiate 3 🎨 emoji tiles**: in HomePage.tsx — Color Blocks, Drawing Challenge, Color Mixer currently all use 🎨. Replace 2 of them with distinct emojis (🟪 for Color Blocks, 🌈 for Color Mixer, keep 🎨 for Drawing Challenge — or use your judgment). Pre-readers can't distinguish them otherwise per audit U22.
3. **Age badges**: small pill in corner of each home tile showing target age range. E.g., MathFacts → "🧒 5+", Sudoku → "🧒 7+", BubblePop → "🧒 3+". Use a consistent visual style. Get age data from audit Stage 6 V3 table or pick reasonable values.
4. **Mobile "How to play" ⓘ affordance**: per game, the existing "How to play" section is `hidden md:block` (per audit U23). Add a small ⓘ button in GameLayout (or per-page) that, when tapped, shows the instructions in a small popover/modal. Or alternatively: remove `hidden md:block` from the simplest possible games and make the instructions always visible inline at the bottom of the screen.

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5b: drawing Undo/Redo with 20-frame history"

content.subject: PR-6b: Motion & timing

content.subject: PR-5a1: Pictographic difficulty selectors (7 games)
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5a1 (~L213-217). Replace text "Easy / Medium / Hard" difficulty selectors with pictographic icons (🐣/🐱/🦁 or similar age-appropriate animals) across: PopBalloons, SimonSays, MemoryMatch, Snake, MathFacts, ShapeSorting, ColorMixer.

ACTIONS:
1. For each of the 7 games, find the difficulty selector UI in the Page.tsx (or in the in-game settings panel).
2. Replace text labels with emoji/icon buttons. Keep aria-label="Easy"/"Medium"/"Hard" intact for screen readers (this is the gemini critic's measurable acceptance — and good a11y).
3. Use consistent icons across all games: 🐣 (easy / baby chick), 🐱 (medium / cat), 🦁 (hard / lion). Add a "kid-button" Tailwind class for size if needed.

ACCEPTANCE:
- `grep -rE "(>Easy<|>Medium<|>Hard<)" src/components/Games/*/[A-Z]*Page.tsx` returns 0 matches in the difficulty-selector buttons themselves (the visible button text). Aria-labels MAY still contain those words (acceptable).
- All 7 games' difficulty selectors render the 3 emoji buttons (manual check)
- Each emoji has a corresponding aria-label
- Per-PR gate green: lint + type-check + test --run + test:games + test:touch + playwright + build

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5a1: pictographic difficulty selectors (7 games)"

content.subject: PR-5a2: Win celebrations (3 games)
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5a2 (~L219-222). Replace black-overlay game-over modals on Snake, PopBalloons, SimonSays with celebratory pattern. BLOCKED BY #15 (PR-5a1 — same Page.tsx files for Snake/PopBalloons/SimonSays).

ACTIONS:
1. Pick ONE simple approach: either (a) hand-rolled emoji-burst animation using `position: absolute` divs + CSS keyframes already set up in PR-2 BubblePop pattern, or (b) add the `canvas-confetti` npm dep (~5KB minified). Plan v3 explicitly says DO NOT hand-roll a custom particle engine (the architect critic flagged this as risk).
2. For each game's game-over modal: trigger confetti + playSound('victory') (or 'gameover' for lose).
3. Replace the `fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-50` with a friendlier pastel + rounded card.

ACCEPTANCE:
- The 3 games show celebratory animation on win (manual confirm in Chrome DevTools)
- A NEW test file (per-game or shared) asserts the celebration mounts/unmounts cleanly (no leaked confetti DOM nodes after game-over modal closes)
- On a 360px DevTools viewport, animation runs at ≥30 FPS (manual sample; OK to verify once and note in PR description)
- Per-PR gate green

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5a2: celebratory game-over modals (3 games)"

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5b: drawing Undo/Redo with 20-frame history"

content.subject: PR-5c1: Sudoku hint
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5c1 (~L232-234). Add hint feature to Sudoku. Independent.

ACTIONS:
1. Add a "💡 Hint" button to SudokuPage.tsx header (in `headerActions` slot of GameLayout).
2. On click: find one empty cell, look up its solution value from the puzzle's solution, briefly highlight it (border or pulse animation), reveal the digit for ~3 sec before fading.
3. Limit to 3 hints per game. Store `hintsUsed` in game state. Show counter near button: "💡 Hint (2/3 left)".
4. Persist hintsUsed in the game's stored state (existing kda:sudoku key) so it survives reloads.

ACCEPTANCE:
- src/hooks/useSudokuGame.test.ts NEW or extended:
   * "hint returns coordinate matching solution" — call hint, assert returned cell value equals solution[cell]
   * "hint counter caps at 3" — call 4× in a row, assert 4th is no-op
- Per-PR gate green

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5c1: Sudoku hint feature (max 3 per game)"

content.subject: PR-5c2: ColorMixer thermometer
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5c2 (~L236-237). Add proximity feedback indicator to ColorMixer. Independent.

ACTIONS:
1. Calculate proximity: `const distance = Math.sqrt((r-tr)**2 + (g-tg)**2 + (b-tb)**2) / Math.sqrt(255*255*3); const proximity = 1 - distance;` (proximity 0..1).
2. Render a vertical thermometer-style indicator: 0 = cold/empty, 1 = full/hot. Pulse animation when proximity > 0.95 (very close to match).
3. Place next to the target color swatch in ColorMixerPage.tsx.

ACCEPTANCE:
- src/hooks/useColorMixer.test.ts NEW (or extend):
   * "proximity is 1.0 at exact match" — current RGB equals target, assert proximity === 1
   * "proximity is 0 at max distance" — current black, target white, assert proximity === 0
- Per-PR gate green

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5c2: ColorMixer proximity thermometer indicator"

content.subject: PR-5d: First-run onboarding overlay
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5d (~L239-241). Pictographic 4-step onboarding overlay shown on first app launch. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs.

ACTIONS:
1. Create src/components/Onboarding/OnboardingOverlay.tsx. Renders a modal/full-screen overlay with 4 steps:
   - Step 1: 🎮 "Pick a game!" — point to home tiles
   - Step 2: 👆 "Tap to play!" — pictographic demo of tap interaction
   - Step 3: 🌟 "Check today's challenge!" — point to Daily Drawing Prompt
   - Step 4: 🖼️ "Save your art!" — point to drawing → Gallery flow
   Use big emoji + minimal text. Pre-readers should grok it from icons alone.
2. Each step has a "Next →" or "Got it!" button (final). Pre-readers can use emoji icons.
3. Gate visibility on `storage.get('firstRunComplete', false)`. On dismiss (any step's final button), `storage.set('firstRunComplete', true)`.
4. Wire into App.tsx so the overlay renders ABOVE HomePage on first load and never again.

ACCEPTANCE:
- src/components/Onboarding/OnboardingOverlay.test.tsx NEW:
   * Mount with `firstRunComplete=false`, assert overlay visible
   * Click through to step 4 and dismiss, assert storage.get('firstRunComplete') === true
   * Re-render with `firstRunComplete=true`, assert overlay NOT in DOM
- Per-PR gate green

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5d: first-run onboarding overlay (4-step pictographic)"

content.subject: PR-6a: Accessibility compliance basics
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-6a (~L245-251). The largest Phase 6 PR. Touches HomePage tiles, global CSS focus-visible, several game pages.

ACTIONS:
1. **aria-label every home tile button** in HomePage.tsx (currently screen readers announce raw emoji codepoint names per audit U9). Also: the 3 feature-highlight "tiles" that are non-interactive should get `role="presentation"` or be converted to non-button elements.
2. **Global focus-visible**: in src/index.css add `*:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ring, #6366f1); outline-offset: 2px; }`. Tailwind preflight strips browser defaults; this restores them per audit U11.
3. **ColorPicker keyboard activation**: in src/components/Tools/ColorPicker.tsx, swatches use `role="button"` divs but have no onKeyDown handler. Add `onKeyDown` that fires the same handler on Enter/Space keys.
4. **MathFacts input label**: add a `<label>` element associated with the answer input (currently placeholder-only violates WCAG 1.3.1 per audit U15).
5. **SimonSays glyph per color**: add a glyph/letter inside each colored button (W3C 1.4.1 requires more than color alone to distinguish UI elements).

ACCEPTANCE:
- **NEW automated Playwright test** `tests/e2e/keyboard-nav.spec.ts` (per gemini critic):
   * Load home page (use the pre-seeded firstRunComplete pattern from home-navigation.spec.ts beforeEach)
   * Press Tab until first tile gets focus
   * Assert focus outline visible (computed style check)
   * Press Enter, assert game opens
- **ALSO NEW** Playwright test `tests/e2e/onboarding.spec.ts` (per Phase 5 gemini recommendation — closes the e2e gap created by pre-seeding firstRunComplete elsewhere):
   * Load home page with EXPLICITLY NOT pre-seeded firstRunComplete (use a fresh context.addInitScript that removes the key OR omits it)
   * Assert OnboardingOverlay is visible
   * Click through 4 steps, assert dismissed
   * Reload, assert overlay NOT visible (firstRunComplete now true)
- `grep -c 'aria-label' src/components/HomePage.tsx` >= 14 (one per game tile + Gallery tile)
- ColorPicker: render in test, simulate Space keypress on a swatch, assert color changed
- Per-PR gate green: lint + type-check + test --run + test:games + test:touch + playwright + build

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 6 PR-6a: a11y compliance — aria-labels, focus-visible, keyboard nav, label, SimonSays glyphs + new onboarding e2e"

content.subject: PR-6b: Motion & timing
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-6b (~L253-258).

ACTIONS:
1. **prefers-reduced-motion**: in src/index.css add `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }`. Cuts the 47 animation usages identified in audit U10 when user has the OS setting on. Also explicitly disable canvas-confetti in useWinCelebration when prefers-reduced-motion matches (use `window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches`).
2. **visibilitychange pause**: in useJellyVolleyball, useSnakeGame, usePopBalloons — listen on `document.visibilitychange`, pause game loop / cancel rAF / clear interval when hidden, resume when visible. Cleanup listener on unmount.
3. **Google Fonts preconnect**: in index.html, replace any `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/...')` in src/index.css with `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">` + `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>` + `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/...&display=swap">` in index.html head.
4. **Constrain touch-action**: in src/index.css, replace the `* { touch-action: manipulation }` rule (which kills iOS scroll momentum per audit U7) with rules scoped only to game canvases (`.game-canvas, [data-touch-game] { touch-action: none; }`). Add the class to canvas elements as needed.

ACCEPTANCE:
- Manual verification: enable prefers-reduced-motion in DevTools, load BubblePop — bubbles still spawn but animations are near-instant
- Page Performance: with throttled mobile profile, Lighthouse mobile a11y ≥ 90 (note in PR description — measure once)
- Per-PR gate green (note: not all browsers test reduced-motion in CI, manual check OK)

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 6 PR-6b: prefers-reduced-motion, visibilitychange pause, font preconnect, touch-action scoping"

content.subject: PR-6c: Polish + perf (TetrisBoard memo + tile differentiation + age badges + ⓘ)
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-6c (~L260-264). Smaller polish-grade improvements.

ACTIONS:
1. **React.memo TetrisBoard CellView**: in src/components/Games/Tetris/TetrisBoard.tsx (or wherever CellView lives), wrap the cell component in React.memo. Currently all 200 cells re-render every 800ms tick.
2. **Differentiate 3 🎨 emoji tiles**: in HomePage.tsx — Color Blocks, Drawing Challenge, Color Mixer currently all use 🎨. Replace 2 of them with distinct emojis (🟪 for Color Blocks, 🌈 for Color Mixer, keep 🎨 for Drawing Challenge — or use your judgment). Pre-readers can't distinguish them otherwise per audit U22.
3. **Age badges**: small pill in corner of each home tile showing target age range. E.g., MathFacts → "🧒 5+", Sudoku → "🧒 7+", BubblePop → "🧒 3+". Use a consistent visual style. Get age data from audit Stage 6 V3 table or pick reasonable values.
4. **Mobile "How to play" ⓘ affordance**: per game, the existing "How to play" section is `hidden md:block` (per audit U23). Add a small ⓘ button in GameLayout (or per-page) that, when tapped, shows the instructions in a small popover/modal. Or alternatively: remove `hidden md:block` from the simplest possible games and make the instructions always visible inline at the bottom of the screen.

ACCEPTANCE:
- TetrisBoard: verify via React DevTools Profiler (or note expected behavior) that CellView is now memoized — cells should not re-render unless their props change
- HomePage: `grep -c '🎨' src/components/HomePage.tsx` returns ≤1
- Age badges: visible on all 14 home tiles (manual check + maybe a test that asserts the badge prop on the tile component)
- Mobile "How to play" affordance: works on a 360px viewport (manual confirm)
- Per-PR gate green

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 6 PR-6c: TetrisBoard memo, tile emoji differentiation, age badges, mobile how-to-play"

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

content.subject: PR-6a: Accessibility compliance basics
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-6a (~L245-251). The largest Phase 6 PR. Touches HomePage tiles, global CSS focus-visible, several game pages.

ACTIONS:
1. **aria-label every home tile button** in HomePage.tsx (currently screen readers announce raw emoji codepoint names per audit U9). Also: the 3 feature-highlight "tiles" that are non-interactive should get `role="presentation"` or be converted to non-button elements.
2. **Global focus-visible**: in src/index.css add `*:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ring, #6366f1); outline-offset: 2px; }`. Tailwind preflight strips browser defaults; this restores them per audit U11.
3. **ColorPicker keyboard activation**: in src/components/Tools/ColorPicker.tsx, swatches use `role="button"` divs but have no onKeyDown handler. Add `onKeyDown` that fires the same handler on Enter/Space keys.
4. **MathFacts input label**: add a `<label>` element associated with the answer input (currently placeholder-only violates WCAG 1.3.1 per audit U15).
5. **SimonSays glyph per color**: add a glyph/letter inside each colored button (W3C 1.4.1 requires more than color alone to distinguish UI elements).

ACCEPTANCE:
- **NEW automated Playwright test** `tests/e2e/keyboard-nav.spec.ts` (per gemini critic):
   * Load home page (use the pre-seeded firstRunComplete pattern from home-navigation.spec.ts beforeEach)
   * Press Tab until first tile gets focus
   * Assert focus outline visible (computed style check)
   * Press Enter, assert game opens

   * Assert OnboardingOverlay is visible
   * Click through 4 steps, assert dismissed
   * Reload, assert overlay NOT visible (firstRunComplete now true)
- `grep -c 'aria-label' src/components/HomePage.tsx` >= 14 (one per game tile + Gallery tile)
- ColorPicker: render in test, simulate Space keypress on a swatch, assert color changed

content.subject: PR-6b: Motion & timing
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-6b (~L253-258).

ACTIONS:
1. **prefers-reduced-motion**: in src/index.css add `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }`. Cuts the 47 animation usages identified in audit U10 when user has the OS setting on. Also explicitly disable canvas-confetti in useWinCelebration when prefers-reduced-motion matches (use `window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches`).
2. **visibilitychange pause**: in useJellyVolleyball, useSnakeGame, usePopBalloons — listen on `document.visibilitychange`, pause game loop / cancel rAF / clear interval when hidden, resume when visible. Cleanup listener on unmount.
3. **Google Fonts preconnect**: in index.html, replace any `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/...')` in src/index.css with `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">` + `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>` + `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/...&display=swap">` in index.html head.
4. **Constrain touch-action**: in src/index.css, replace the `* { touch-action: manipulation }` rule (which kills iOS scroll momentum per audit U7) with rules scoped only to game canvases (`.game-canvas, [data-touch-game] { touch-action: none; }`). Add the class to canvas elements as needed.

ACCEPTANCE:
- Manual verification: enable prefers-reduced-motion in DevTools, load BubblePop — bubbles still spawn but animations are near-instant
- Page Performance: with throttled mobile profile, Lighthouse mobile a11y ≥ 90 (note in PR description — measure once)
- Per-PR gate green (note: not all browsers test reduced-motion in CI, manual check OK)

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 6 PR-6b: prefers-reduced-motion, visibilitychange pause, font preconnect, touch-action scoping"

content.subject: PR-6c: Polish + perf (TetrisBoard memo + tile differentiation + age badges + ⓘ)

Add a small ⓘ button in GameLayout (or per-page) that, when tapped, shows the instructions in a small popover/modal. content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

content.subject: PR-5c2: ColorMixer thermometer
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5c2 (~L236-237). Add proximity feedback indicator to ColorMixer. Independent.

ACTIONS:
1. Calculate proximity: `const distance = Math.sqrt((r-tr)**2 + (g-tg)**2 + (b-tb)**2) / Math.sqrt(255*255*3); const proximity = 1 - distance;` (proximity 0..1).
2. Render a vertical thermometer-style indicator: 0 = cold/empty, 1 = full/hot. Pulse animation when proximity > 0.95 (very close to match).
3. Place next to the target color swatch in ColorMixerPage.tsx.

ACCEPTANCE:
- src/hooks/useColorMixer.test.ts NEW (or extend):
   * "proximity is 1.0 at exact match" — current RGB equals target, assert proximity === 1
   * "proximity is 0 at max distance" — current black, target white, assert proximity === 0
- Per-PR gate green

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5c2: ColorMixer proximity thermometer indicator"

content.subject: PR-5d: First-run onboarding overlay
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5d (~L239-241). Pictographic 4-step onboarding overlay shown on first app launch. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs.

ACTIONS:
1. Create src/components/Onboarding/OnboardingOverlay.tsx. Renders a modal/full-screen overlay with 4 steps:
   - Step 1: 🎮 "Pick a game!" — point to home tiles
   - Step 2: 👆 "Tap to play!" — pictographic demo of tap interaction
   - Step 3: 🌟 "Check today's challenge!" — point to Daily Drawing Prompt
   - Step 4: 🖼️ "Save your art!" — point to drawing → Gallery flow
   Use big emoji + minimal text. Pre-readers should grok it from icons alone.
2. Each step has a "Next →" or "Got it!" button (final). Pre-readers can use emoji icons.
3. Gate visibility on `storage.get('firstRunComplete', false)`. On dismiss (any step's final button), `storage.set('firstRunComplete', true)`.
4. Wire into App.tsx so the overlay renders ABOVE HomePage on first load and never again.

ACCEPTANCE:
- src/components/Onboarding/OnboardingOverlay.test.tsx NEW:
   * Mount with `firstRunComplete=false`, assert overlay visible
   * Click through to step 4 and dismiss, assert storage.get('firstRunComplete') === true
   * Re-render with `firstRunComplete=true`, assert overlay NOT in DOM
- Per-PR gate green

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5d: first-run onboarding overlay (4-step pictographic)"

content.subject: PR-6a: Accessibility compliance basics
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-6a (~L245-251). The largest Phase 6 PR. Touches HomePage tiles, global CSS focus-visible, several game pages.

ACTIONS:
1. **aria-label every home tile button** in HomePage.tsx (currently screen readers announce raw emoji codepoint names per audit U9). Also: the 3 feature-highlight "tiles" that are non-interactive should get `role="presentation"` or be converted to non-button elements.
2. **Global focus-visible**: in src/index.css add `*:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ring, #6366f1); outline-offset: 2px; }`. Tailwind preflight strips browser defaults; this restores them per audit U11.
3. **ColorPicker keyboard activation**: in src/components/Tools/ColorPicker.tsx, swatches use `role="button"` divs but have no onKeyDown handler. Add `onKeyDown` that fires the same handler on Enter/Space keys.
4. **MathFacts input label**: add a `<label>` element associated with the answer input (currently placeholder-only violates WCAG 1.3.1 per audit U15).
5. **SimonSays glyph per color**: add a glyph/letter inside each colored button (W3C 1.4.1 requires more than color alone to distinguish UI elements).

ACCEPTANCE:
- **NEW automated Playwright test** `tests/e2e/keyboard-nav.spec.ts` (per gemini critic):
   * Load home page (use the pre-seeded firstRunComplete pattern from home-navigation.spec.ts beforeEach)
   * Press Tab until first tile gets focus
   * Assert focus outline visible (computed style check)
   * Press Enter, assert game opens
- **ALSO NEW** Playwright test `tests/e2e/onboarding.spec.ts` (per Phase 5 gemini recommendation — closes the e2e gap created by pre-seeding firstRunComplete elsewhere):
   * Load home page with EXPLICITLY NOT pre-seeded firstRunComplete (use a fresh context.addInitScript that removes the key OR omits it)
   * Assert OnboardingOverlay is visible
   * Click through 4 steps, assert dismissed
   * Reload, assert overlay NOT visible (firstRunComplete now true)
- `grep -c 'aria-label' src/components/HomePage.tsx` >= 14 (one per game tile + Gallery tile)
- ColorPicker: render in test, simulate Space keypress on a swatch, assert color changed
- Per-PR gate green: lint + type-check + test --run + test:games + test:touch + playwright + build

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 6 PR-6a: a11y compliance — aria-labels, focus-visible, keyboard nav, label, SimonSays glyphs + new onboarding e2e"

content.subject: PR-6b: Motion & timing
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-6b (~L253-258).

ACTIONS:
1. **prefers-reduced-motion**: in src/index.css add `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }`. Cuts the 47 animation usages identified in audit U10 when user has the OS setting on. Also explicitly disable canvas-confetti in useWinCelebration when prefers-reduced-motion matches (use `window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches`).
2. **visibilitychange pause**: in useJellyVolleyball, useSnakeGame, usePopBalloons — listen on `document.visibilitychange`, pause game loop / cancel rAF / clear interval when hidden, resume when visible. Cleanup listener on unmount.
3. **Google Fonts preconnect**: in index.html, replace any `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/...')` in src/index.css with `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">` + `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>` + `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/...&display=swap">` in index.html head.
4. **Constrain touch-action**: in src/index.css, replace the `* { touch-action: manipulation }` rule (which kills iOS scroll momentum per audit U7) with rules scoped only to game canvases (`.game-canvas, [data-touch-game] { touch-action: none; }`). Add the class to canvas elements as needed.

ACCEPTANCE:
- Manual verification: enable prefers-reduced-motion in DevTools, load BubblePop — bubbles still spawn but animations are near-instant
- Page Performance: with throttled mobile profile, Lighthouse mobile a11y ≥ 90 (note in PR description — measure once)
- Per-PR gate green (note: not all browsers test reduced-motion in CI, manual check OK)

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 6 PR-6b: prefers-reduced-motion, visibilitychange pause, font preconnect, touch-action scoping"

content.subject: PR-6c: Polish + perf (TetrisBoard memo + tile differentiation + age badges + ⓘ)
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-6c (~L260-264). Smaller polish-grade improvements.

ACTIONS:
1. **React.memo TetrisBoard CellView**: in src/components/Games/Tetris/TetrisBoard.tsx (or wherever CellView lives), wrap the cell component in React.memo. Currently all 200 cells re-render every 800ms tick.
2. **Differentiate 3 🎨 emoji tiles**: in HomePage.tsx — Color Blocks, Drawing Challenge, Color Mixer currently all use 🎨. Replace 2 of them with distinct emojis (🟪 for Color Blocks, 🌈 for Color Mixer, keep 🎨 for Drawing Challenge — or use your judgment). Pre-readers can't distinguish them otherwise per audit U22.
3. **Age badges**: small pill in corner of each home tile showing target age range. E.g., MathFacts → "🧒 5+", Sudoku → "🧒 7+", BubblePop → "🧒 3+". Use a consistent visual style. Get age data from audit Stage 6 V3 table or pick reasonable values.
4. **Mobile "How to play" ⓘ affordance**: per game, the existing "How to play" section is `hidden md:block` (per audit U23). Add a small ⓘ button in GameLayout (or per-page) that, when tapped, shows the instructions in a small popover/modal. Or alternatively: remove `hidden md:block` from the simplest possible games and make the instructions always visible inline at the bottom of the screen.

ACCEPTANCE:
- TetrisBoard: verify via React DevTools Profiler (or note expected behavior) that CellView is now memoized — cells should not re-render unless their props change
- HomePage: `grep -c '🎨' src/components/HomePage.tsx` returns ≤1
- Age badges: visible on all 14 home tiles (manual check + maybe a test that asserts the badge prop on the tile component)
- Mobile "How to play" affordance: works on a 360px viewport (manual confirm)
- Per-PR gate green

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 6 PR-6c: TetrisBoard memo, tile emoji differentiation, age badges, mobile how-to-play"

{/* Instructions - Hidden on mobile */}

How to Play

🎯 Goal

Pop as many balloons as you can before time runs out! Avoid the bombs!

🎮 How to Play

  • Tap balloons quickly to pop them before they disappear
  • Normal balloons give you +10 points
  • Golden balloons (⭐) give you +30 points
  • Avoid bombs (💣) - they cost you a life!
  • Missing a balloon also costs a life
  • Game ends when time runs out or you lose all lives

🔥 Combos

Pop balloons quickly in succession to build a combo! Each combo level adds +5 bonus points. The combo resets if you miss a balloon, hit a bomb, or wait too long between pops.

⚙️ Difficulty

🐌 Easy:
  • • Slower spawn rate (1.5s)
  • • Balloons stay longer (2s)
  • • No bombs!
  • • 5 starting lives
🏃 Medium:
  • • Faster spawns (1s)
  • • Shorter lifetime (1.5s)
  • • 10% bombs
  • • 3 starting lives
⚡ Hard:
  • • Very fast spawns (0.7s)
  • • Quick lifetime (1.2s)
  • • 20% bombs!
  • • 3 starting lives
  • • More golden balloons (15%)

💡 Tips

  • Focus on golden balloons for big points!
  • Watch out for the bomb warning (⚠️)
  • Build combos by popping balloons quickly
  • Don't let balloons disappear - you'll lose a life!
  • Practice makes perfect!

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5b: drawing Undo/Redo with 20-frame history"

content.subject: PR-6b: Motion & timing
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-6b (~L253-258).

ACTIONS:
1. **prefers-reduced-motion**: in src/index.css add `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }`. Cuts the 47 animation usages identified in audit U10 when user has the OS setting on. Also explicitly disable canvas-confetti in useWinCelebration when prefers-reduced-motion matches (use `window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches`).
2. **visibilitychange pause**: in useJellyVolleyball, useSnakeGame, usePopBalloons — listen on `document.visibilitychange`, pause game loop / cancel rAF / clear interval when hidden, resume when visible. Cleanup listener on unmount.
3. **Google Fonts preconnect**: in index.html, replace any `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/...')` in src/index.css with `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">` + `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>` + `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/...&display=swap">` in index.html head.
4. **Constrain touch-action**: in src/index.css, replace the `* { touch-action: manipulation }` rule (which kills iOS scroll momentum per audit U7) with rules scoped only to game canvases (`.game-canvas, [data-touch-game] { touch-action: none; }`). Add the class to canvas elements as needed.

1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):

   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap

- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

content.subject: PR-6b: Motion & timing
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-6b (~L253-258).

ACTIONS:
1. **prefers-reduced-motion**: in src/index.css add `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }`. Cuts the 47 animation usages identified in audit U10 when user has the OS setting on. Also explicitly disable canvas-confetti in useWinCelebration when prefers-reduced-motion matches (use `window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches`).
2. **visibilitychange pause**: in useJellyVolleyball, useSnakeGame, usePopBalloons — listen on `document.visibilitychange`, pause game loop / cancel rAF / clear interval when hidden, resume when visible. Cleanup listener on unmount.
3. **Google Fonts preconnect**: in index.html, replace any `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/...')` in src/index.css with `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">` + `<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>` + `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/...&display=swap">` in index.html head.
4. **Constrain touch-action**: in src/index.css, replace the `* { touch-action: manipulation }` rule (which kills iOS scroll momentum per audit U7) with rules scoped only to game canvases (`.game-canvas, [data-touch-game] { touch-action: none; }`). Add the class to canvas elements as needed.

ACCEPTANCE:
- Manual verification: enable prefers-reduced-motion in DevTools, load BubblePop — bubbles still spawn but animations are near-instant
- Page Performance: with throttled mobile profile, Lighthouse mobile a11y ≥ 90 (note in PR description — measure once)
- Per-PR gate green (note: not all browsers test reduced-motion in CI, manual check OK)

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 6 PR-6b: prefers-reduced-motion, visibilitychange pause, font preconnect, touch-action scoping"

content.subject: PR-5b: Drawing Undo/Redo
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5b (~L224-230). Add canvas history stack to useCanvas. Independent of other Phase 5 PRs (touches useCanvas, DrawingPage, DrawingCanvasWithTools — disjoint from game files).

ACTIONS:
1. In useCanvas.ts, add a history stack: `const historyRef = useRef<string[]>([])` storing compressed dataURLs (canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7)). Max 20 frames. Push on every stroke completion (touchend / mouseup).
2. Add `undo()` and `redo()` functions: undo pops latest frame, drawImage's previous into canvas. Redo unpops. A NEW stroke after undo invalidates forward history (standard undo/redo semantics).
3. Expose `{ undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo }` from useCanvas.
4. Add ↩️ Undo and ↪️ Redo buttons in DrawingCanvasWithTools.tsx tool panel. Disable when canUndo/canRedo is false.
5. Watch performance: if pushing a dataURL adds >5ms per stroke, throttle to every-N-strokes.

ACCEPTANCE (per the critic's explicit named test cases):
- src/hooks/useCanvas.test.ts (extension or new) with these specific named tests:
   * "undo after clear" — clear canvas, undo, assert previous frame restored
   * "undo during stencil overlay" — apply stencil, undo, assert stencil removed
   * "redo after new stroke invalidates forward history" — undo, draw new stroke, assert canRedo === false
   * "history capped at 20" — 21 strokes, oldest evicted, redo unavailable past cap
- Per-PR gate green
- Manual: draw → undo → redo → see strokes appear/disappear
- DEFER TRIGGER (per plan v3 line 213): if implementation takes >4h OR canvas history adds >5ms per stroke OR animation drops below 45 FPS, mark task in_progress and notify team-lead — DO NOT silently land a slow undo.

COMMIT: ONE commit. Message: "Phase 5 PR-5b: drawing Undo/Redo with 20-frame history"

content.subject: PR-5c2: ColorMixer thermometer
content.description:
Plan v3 PR-5c2 (~L236-237). Add proximity feedback indicator to ColorMixer. Independent.

ACTIONS:
1. Calculate proximity: `const distance = Math.sqrt((r-tr)**2 + (g-tg)**2 + (b-tb)**2) / Math.sqrt(255*255*3); const proximity = 1 - distance;` (proximity 0..1).
2. Render a vertical thermometer-style indicator: 0 = cold/empty, 1 = full/hot. Pulse animation when proximity > 0.95 (very close to match).
3. Place next to the target color swatch in ColorMixerPage.tsx.

ACCEPTANCE:
- src/hooks/useColorMixer.test.ts NEW (or extend):
   * "proximity is 1.0 at exact match" — current RGB equals target, assert proximity === 1
   * "proximity is 0 at max distance" — current black, target white, assert proximity === 0
- Per-PR gate green
